author: raymond91125
body:
Dear all, 

The proposal has been made to obsolete (with replacements)
(These terms are about down stream effects, not the signaling pathway itself.)
GO:0006978 DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator resulting in transcription of p21 class mediator
GO:1902163 negative regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator resulting in transcription of p21 class mediator
GO:1902162 negulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator resulting in transcription of p21 class mediator
GO:1902164 positive regulation of DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator resulting in transcription of p21 class mediator
GO:0006977 DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator resulting in cell cycle arrest


see https://github.com/geneontology/go-ontology/issues/26003.

Experimental annotations that need to be reviewed are here: 
https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/19UHvd0A4oSMgA684FAWuFp3TDTqvZ2sYdX4wNKxMV2c/edit?gid=0#gid=0

Impacted groups: 
BHF-UCL	2 - done
CAFA	5
HGNC-UCL	1 - done
MGI	7
PINC	1
Reactome	8
UniProt	25
ZFIN	1

** Group contacts: https://github.com/geneontology/go-site/blob/master/metadata/group-contacts.csv
----

Mappings that need to be reviewed: (InterPro2GO, UniProt-Keywords, UniRule) 
None.


Thanks.
title: Review annotations to GO:0006978 DNA damage response, signal transduction by p53 class mediator resulting in transcription of p21 class mediator and related terms

body: Reactome fixed as suggested. Corrections will become visible in March 2025 release.
